notice: Synthetic rule-priority experiments. All cases are fictional. Expected outputs describe the current EACT-v1 first-match rule order; they are not asserted to be universally correct policy decisions.

cases.title: Integrity mismatch while source unavailable
cases.reason: Current implementation checks an integrity mismatch before source availability.

cases.title: Revoked credential and subject mismatch
cases.reason: Current implementation returns credential status before checking subject mismatch.

cases.title: Unknown issuer and revoked status claim
cases.reason: Current implementation returns issuer-unverified before considering status or subject fields.

cases.title: Authenticated issuer and subject mismatch
cases.reason: Subject mismatch is returned when issuer and source evidence are otherwise available.

cases.title: Authenticated issuer but status endpoint unavailable
cases.reason: Current rule reports partial verification while explicitly leaving status unknown.

cases.title: Integrity mismatch while consent is pending
cases.reason: Current implementation prioritises a confirmed integrity mismatch over a pending consent workflow.

cases.title: Consent pending with no other verified evidence
cases.reason: Current implementation returns a pending-consent state before issuer or completeness checks.
